# RAM Sustainable Development | رام للتنمية المستدامة

RAM Sustainable Development is a Muscat-based company whose debt collection department was established in the Sultanate of Oman in 2018, building on debt-recovery experience dating to 2012 across the Gulf region and Türkiye. The company profile describes an ethical, documented, case-specific approach focused on resolution, commercial relationships, confidentiality, and financial interests.

Website: https://www.ramsdgroup.com

English: https://www.ramsdgroup.com/en

Phone: +968 7171 2701

Sector pages: /ar/industries | /en/industries

## Method

RAM's published method covers case evaluation, strategy development, debtor communication, negotiation and settlement, legal referral where necessary, monitoring and reporting, judgment enforcement coordination, and closure. Legal advice and court representation are provided by licensed specialists in the relevant jurisdiction.

Method pages: /ar/how-we-work | /en/how-we-work

## Integrity and confidentiality

RAM states that it operates in alignment with the laws of the Sultanate of Oman and recognized international debt-collection guidance. Published operating principles include respectful communication, no harassment or unlawful pressure, need-to-know access, controlled disclosure, secure channels for sensitive records, and documented handling.

Compliance: /ar/compliance-and-confidentiality | /en/compliance-and-confidentiality
Privacy: /ar/privacy | /en/privacy

## Knowledge hub

RAM publishes Arabic and English guides covering amicable versus legal recovery, claim-file preparation, receivables warning signs, recovery timeline factors, payment-plan design, cross-border claim preparation, invoice disputes, and preservation of commercial relationships.

Insights: /ar/insights | /en/insights

## Important limitations

- Website content is general information and not legal, financial, accounting, or other professional advice.
- Recovery outcomes and timelines cannot be guaranteed.
- Cross-border and legal matters require review of the facts, records, and relevant jurisdiction.
- Do not send identity records, bank information, full contracts, or other sensitive documents through the public contact form.
